verdict.rationale: Checkout.com documents Payment Links that can be sent over email, SMS and social without coding, and a hosted payment page. Together these give a hosted, pay-online request, which approximates the payment half of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows true invoice objects (line items, due dates, invoice documents) or automatic dunning or reminder scheduling. Missing for 10: hosted invoice documents, automatic payment reminders, invoice lifecycle management for finance-ops users, and independent corroboration.
